newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Grinaker says announcement in next 2 days.
newsitem.headline: Grinaker says announcement in next 2 days.

text.p: Grinaker Holdings Ltd managing director Jack Saulez said on Thursday an announcement on a cautionary notice published this week will be made within the next two days.
"The announcement should be out either on Friday or Monday," Saulez told Reuters.

He said Wednesday's cautionary which said that Grinaker, its electronics subsidiary Grintek Ltd, Grintek unit Siltek Ltd and Siltek associate Q Data Ltd were in talks, was related to the ongoing restructuring of the group.
"It is related, but I cannot give any more details ahead of the announcement that we are preparing right now," he said.

Analysts said on Wednesday that the notice was likely to signal a restructure of the group's electronic interests, following the unbundling and separate listing of its construction interests last year.
One analyst suggested the collapse of pyramid holding firm Grinaker and possibly Grintek as well and housing Grintek's electronic interests in Siltek as a possible streamlined structure.

Grintek shares listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange were active on Thursday with over two million changing hands in a bookover deal -- where a single brokerage matches both buyer and seller. By 1056 GMT the shares had dipped five cents to 345 cents, after rising 15 cents on Wednesday.
Grinaker's shares lost 10 cents to 940 cents, but Siltek and Q Data were firm, the former adding 25 cents to 20.50 rand and the latter jumping 28 cents, or three percent, to 938 cents.

Saulez said earlier this month that Grintek and Siltek could add about 500 million rand to their share values through an unbundling. At the time he ruled out a listing of its electronics unit as he said it was "too small" although partners may be found for it.
